applicability: Siting criteria govern where a kiln may be established. Courts have read the 2022 central rules as applying to kilns established on or after 22 February 2022, and the UP 2026 amendment regularises some kilns built before the 2012 rules. A measured distance inside a threshold is a siting flag that needs inspection, never a finding.

verification_levels.secondary_sources: Threshold quoted consistently by court records, legal digests or news reports of the notification; the gazette text itself has not been read.
verification_levels.unverified_compilation: Threshold taken from an academic compilation that cites the rules; neither the gazette text nor a quotation of it has been found.

absence_conclusive: False where OpenStreetMap coverage of the feature is known to be incomplete in rural UP: a mapped feature inside the threshold is a flag, but no mapped feature proves nothing.
